2026-10-27.content:
* **(Google Cloud CLI)** Fixed issue where `gcloud components update` on macOS was stuck and would exit
  immediately after printing "WARNING: Known issue encountered updating Python
  modules", preventing updates to the latest release.
  + However, because this issue is present in the 590.0.0 and 590.0.1 releases,
    existing installations currently at those versions still contain the bug,
    and affected users will need to perform a one-time workaround to become
    unstuck.
  + This can be achieved by running:
    `gcloud components --flags-file=<(echo 'update:')`
  + Users updating from version <=589.0.0 or >=591.0.0 are unaffected and can
    run `gcloud components update` as normal; the workaround is only needed for
    installations currently stuck at version 590.0.0 or 590.0.1.
  + This issue can be tracked at
    <https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/578071727>.

summary.title: gcloud components update fix
summary.summary: A fix has been released for the `gcloud components update` command on macOS, which was previously stuck. Users on versions 590.0.0 or 590.0.1 may need to apply a one-time workaround to update successfully.

2026-10-27.content: * Updated bundled Python to 3.14.9.

summary.title: CLI: Python updated
summary.summary: The Google Cloud CLI has been updated with bundled Python version 3.14.9. This update ensures users have access to the latest Python features and security patches within the CLI environment.

2026-10-27.content: * Promoted `gcloud agent-registry skills`, `gcloud agent-registry skills revisions`, `gcloud agent-registry publishers`, and `gcloud agent-registry findings` command groups to GA.

summary.title: Agent Registry GA
summary.summary: The Agent Registry CLI commands for skills, skills revisions, publishers, and findings have been promoted to General Availability. This release signifies a stable and production-ready experience for managing your agent registry resources.

2026-10-27.content:
* Updated `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` to mask environment variable
  values in the printed `service.yaml`. The saved `service.yaml` file keeps
  the original values.

summary.title: App Engine environment variable update
summary.summary: The `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command has been updated to mask environment variable values in the printed `service.yaml`. This change enhances security by preventing sensitive information from being exposed in the output, while the saved `service.yaml` file retains the original, unmasked values.

2026-10-27.content: * Added `gcloud audit-manager audit-schedules describe` command to describe an audit schedule.

summary.title: Audit Manager: Describe Audit Schedules
summary.summary: You can now describe specific audit schedules using the `gcloud audit-manager audit-schedules describe` command. This enhancement allows for detailed inspection of individual audit schedule configurations.

2026-10-27.content:
* Added `--dispatch-info-output-type` flag to
  `gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways create` and
  `gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways update`, and upstream
  `dispatchInfo` configuration to
  `gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways applications create` and
  `gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways applications update`
  to configure delegated dispatch info headers.

summary.title: Configure delegated dispatch info
summary.summary: You can now configure delegated dispatch info headers using the new `--dispatch-info-output-type` flag in security gateways and applications. This allows for enhanced control over how dispatch information is handled.

2026-10-27.content:
* Updated the bundled `certifi` package to version `2026.10.19` and removed
  the distrusted `AAA Certificate Services` root certificate from bundled
  `httplib2`.

summary.title: BigQuery package updates
summary.summary: The bundled `certifi` package has been updated to version `2026.10.19`. Additionally, the distrusted `AAA Certificate Services` root certificate has been removed from the bundled `httplib2`.

2026-10-27.content:
* Added `--timestamp-granularity` flag to `gcloud bigtable instances tables
  create` and `gcloud bigtable tables create` to configure table timestamp
  granularity (`millis` or `micros`). Microsecond granularity is supported
  only on Enterprise Plus instances.
* Rebuild with 1.26.9 for CVE-2026-94439.

summary.title: Bigtable timestamp granularity option
summary.summary: You can now configure table timestamp granularity to millis or micros when creating Bigtable tables. Microsecond granularity is available for Enterprise Plus instances. This release also includes security updates.

2026-10-27.content: * Updated `gcloud beta dns outbound-endpoints create` to make `--endpoint-ip` flag optional.

summary.title: Cloud DNS Outbound Endpoints Simplified
summary.summary: The `gcloud beta dns outbound-endpoints create` command now supports optional `--endpoint-ip` flags, simplifying the creation of outbound DNS endpoints. This update allows for more flexible configuration of your DNS routing.

2026-10-27.content:
* Promoted `--master-flexible-config`, `--worker-flexible-config`, and
  `--secondary-worker-flexible-config` flags to GA for `gcloud dataproc
  clusters create` and `gcloud dataproc workflow-templates
  set-managed-cluster`.
* Promoted `--worker-flexible-config` and `--secondary-worker-flexible-config`
  flags to GA for `gcloud dataproc clusters update`.

summary.title: Dataproc flexible configurations now generally available
summary.summary: Flexible configurations for Dataproc clusters are now generally available. This update promotes flags like --master-flexible-config, --worker-flexible-config, and --secondary-worker-flexible-config to General Availability for cluster creation and updates. This change simplifies cluster management and enhances flexibility in defining node configurations.

2026-10-27.content:
* Added `--discovery-uri` flag to `gcloud iam workload-identity-pools
  providers create-oidc` and `gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers
  update-oidc` to specify a custom OIDC discovery URI when the identity
  provider does not use the default well-known path.
* Added `--actor-providers` flag to `gcloud iam workload-identity-pools
  providers create-oidc` and `gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers
  update-oidc` to authorize providers in the same pool to issue actor tokens
  for identity delegation.

summary.title: Cloud IAM Updates for Workload Identity Pools
summary.summary: New flags `--discovery-uri` and `--actor-providers` have been added to `gcloud iam workload-identity-pools` commands. These enhancements allow for custom OIDC discovery URIs and enable actor token issuance for identity delegation within the same pool.

2026-10-27.content: * Promote `gcloud redis clusters` basic auth feature related commands to GA track.

summary.title: Memorystore for Redis basic auth GA
summary.summary: Basic authentication commands for Memorystore for Redis clusters are now generally available. This feature enhances security by allowing you to manage authentication directly through gcloud commands.

2026-10-27.content: * Updated cloud spanner emulator to v1.5.59.

summary.title: Spanner Emulator Updated
summary.summary: The Cloud Spanner Emulator has been updated to version 1.5.59. This update brings the latest improvements and fixes to the local development experience for Spanner users.

2026-10-27.content:
* Added `--labels` and `--labels-file` flags to `gcloud storage buckets
  create`.

summary.title: Cloud Storage Bucket Labeling
summary.summary: You can now add labels to your Cloud Storage buckets during creation using the new `--labels` and `--labels-file` flags in the `gcloud storage buckets create` command. This feature simplifies bucket organization and management.

2026-10-27.content:
* Promoted `--identity-type` flag to the beta and GA tracks for `gcloud compute instances create`, `gcloud compute instances update`, and `gcloud compute instance-templates create`.
* Added circuit breakers flags (`--circuit-breakers-max-connections`,
  `--circuit-breakers-max-pending-requests`,
  `--circuit-breakers-max-requests`,
  `--circuit-breakers-max-requests-per-connection`,
  `--circuit-breakers-max-retries`) to `gcloud compute backend-services
  create` and `update` commands, and `--no-circuit-breakers` to the `update`
  command.
* Added colorization for `ACTION`, `HEALTH_STATE`, and `STATUS` columns to
  `gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-instances` in beta and GA.
* Added `--circuit-breakers-connect-timeout` flag to `gcloud compute
  backend-services create` and `update` commands in beta.
* Added `--allowed-actions` flag to `gcloud beta compute instance-groups
  managed update-instances` to specify allowed actions (including
  `restart-in-place`) when updating instances in a managed instance group.
* Added `--update-policy-allowed-actions` flag to `gcloud beta compute
  instance-groups managed create` and `gcloud beta compute instance-groups
  managed update` to specify allowed actions (including `restart-in-place`) in
  a managed instance group's update policy.

summary.title: Compute Engine CLI updates
summary.summary: New flags for instance identity and backend service circuit breakers are now available. Enhancements include improved instance group management and command output colorization.

2026-10-27.content:
* Added `--ai-processing-location` flag to
  `gcloud database-migration conversion-workspaces create|update` to set
  the location where Gemini features process conversion workspace data. Pass an
  empty value to remove a previously set location.

summary.title: Set Gemini Processing Location for Conversion Workspaces
summary.summary: You can now specify the processing location for Gemini features within conversion workspaces using the new --ai-processing-location flag. This flag can be used during creation or update of conversion workspaces. An empty value will remove any previously set location.

2026-10-27.content:
* Promoted `--prioritized` flag on
  `gcloud container fleet|hub rolloutsequences upgrade` command to `GA`.
* Promoted `gcloud container fleet|hub config-management update` command to
  `GA`.

summary.title: New GKE Hub features GA
summary.summary: The `--prioritized` flag for rollout sequences and the `config-management update` command are now generally available. These updates enhance your ability to manage GKE deployments.

2026-10-27.content:
* Added flag `--node-config-update-mode` to
  `gcloud container node-pools update` to trigger live update on nodes.
  Supported values are `LIVE_UPDATE_WITHOUT_DRAIN`.

summary.title: Update Kubernetes nodes live
summary.summary: You can now update your Kubernetes nodes without draining them using the new `--node-config-update-mode` flag in `gcloud container node-pools update`. This allows for live updates, minimizing disruption to your workloads.

2026-10-27.content:
* Added `--group` flag to `gcloud beta network-connectivity transports create`
  to specify the group of the Network Connectivity Center hub that the spokes
  created for this transport should be attached to.

summary.title: New flag for network transport creation
summary.summary: A new flag, `--group`, has been added to the `gcloud beta network-connectivity transports create` command. This flag allows users to specify the group of the Network Connectivity Center hub to which new spokes for this transport should be attached.

2026-10-27.content:
* Promoted `add-override`, `update-override`, `delete-override`,
  `add-inline-ml-exception` and `delete-inline-ml-exception` commands of
  `gcloud network-security security-profiles wildfire-analysis` to GA.
* Promoted WildFire-related flags in
  `gcloud network-security firewall-endpoints create` and
  `gcloud network-security firewall-endpoints update` commands to GA.
* Promoted `gcloud network-security server-tls-policies create` to GA.
* Promoted `gcloud network-security server-tls-policies update` to GA.
* Added `--wildfire-analysis-profile-project` flag to
  `gcloud network-security security-profile-groups update` to support
  project-scoped WildFire Analysis profiles.
* Fixed an issue where
  `gcloud network-security security-profiles wildfire-analysis` modification
  commands failed when specifying a full resource URI without
  `--location=global`.
* Removed `--async` flag from `gcloud beta network-security firewall-endpoints
  wildfire-verdict-change-requests create`. The command now returns the created
  verdict change request directly because the API does not return a
  long-running operation.
* Promoted
  `gcloud network-security firewall-endpoints wildfire-verdict-change-requests`
  command group and its `create`, `get` and `list` commands to GA.

summary.title: Enhanced Network Security Features Now Generally Available
summary.summary: Key network security commands and features, including WildFire analysis and server TLS policies, have been promoted to General Availability. Updates also include enhanced WildFire profile project scoping and fixes for existing commands.

2026-10-27.content:
* Promoted the following command groups to beta:
  + `gcloud beta source-manager branch-rules`
  + `gcloud beta source-manager hooks`
  + `gcloud beta source-manager issues`
  + `gcloud beta source-manager issues comments`
  + `gcloud beta source-manager pull-requests`
  + `gcloud beta source-manager pull-requests comments`

summary.title: Source Manager commands reach beta
summary.summary: Several command groups for Source Manager are now available in beta. This includes functionality for branch rules, hooks, issues, and pull requests. These updates offer enhanced control and management capabilities for your source code repositories.

2026-10-27.content:
* Added `gcloud beta workspace-key-access` command group to manage Workspace
  Key Access endpoints, configs, and operations.

Subscribe to these release notes at <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce>.

summary.title: Workspace Key Access Management
summary.summary: A new command group, `gcloud beta workspace-key-access`, has been added to manage Workspace Key Access endpoints, configurations, and operations. You can subscribe to release notes for updates.
